description: This file contains the implementation of a simple in-memory cache class `SimpleCache1` that adheres to the `Psr\SimpleCache\,CacheInterface`. It provides basic cache operations such as get, set, delete, and their multiple variants.

classes.name: SimpleCache1
classes.description: Default in-memory cache implementation that manages key-value pairs with basic cache operations.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the cache, resetting it to an empty state.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes an entry identified by its key from the cache.

methods.name: deleteMultiple
methods.description: Removes multiple entries from cache specified by an iterable of keys.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key, returning default if the key does not exist.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple values for an iterable of keys, returning an array of key-value pairs.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the cache.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache with an optional time-to-live (TTL).

methods.name: setMultiple
methods.description: Stores multiple key-value pairs in cache, with an optional TTL.
